7973490.name: Five Nights at 巛Ricardo Milos'
7973490.author: orangejuice23
7973490.description: This is originally just a joke game, I made it just for fun in the first place . . [STORY]: You are playing as Balt. tl@b, your mom will take away your laptop to her work for a month (and she might break it) tomorrow morning. So you HAVE TO finish making your new upcoming game/project "Playing KoGaMa at 3:00 AM" in your laptop before your mom takes it away Too bad your friends gonna keep asking you to help their projects and get in your way, slow you down, because you promised to help on their projects before. You must lie to them that you are on phone and can't help them. Then they will get fooled away . . [HOW TO WIN THIS GAME]: 1. Stay in your office room, don't go that far outside 2. Create a game on your purple laptop before 6 AM 3. But if you see someone near your door, HIDE your laptop quickly before he enters your room. After he leaves the room, continue back to creating your game (If you didn't hide your laptop, your laptop privacy gonna drain down to 0 and you'll get game over) That's all the requirements to win the game . . [HELP]: Having trouble understanding the CAMERA MONITOR? -The green halo indicates which CAM you are on currently (The CAMERA MONITOR switches to the next CAM per every 3 seconds by itself) . . [CHARACTERS]: PROTAGONIST: Balt. tl@b (You will be playing as him) ANTAGONISTS: 巛Ricardo Milos Fire Dragon VN jake the nice panda _X_Gaming_cool_boy_X_ raptor firmaX Le Player Of Kogama
